enabled.description: Turn the whole night clock off, including the dimming.

night_time.description: When the panel switches to the night clock. 24 hour, HH:MM.

day_time.description: When it goes back to the home page and full brightness.

return_to.description: Where touching it at night goes: 'last' for whatever page it was on before, 'home' for always the home page. Settings is never counted as the last page.

dim_enabled.description: Fade the brightness down as night approaches.

dim_lead_minutes.description: How long before night the fade starts.

night_brightness.description: Brightness once it is night and nobody is about.

woken_brightness.description: Brightness after somebody touches it during the night.

settle_seconds.description: How long after being touched at night before it dims again.

fireflies.description: Drifting, pulsing points of light on the night clock.

firefly_count.description: How many. More is prettier and costs more to draw.

weather_effects.description: Draw what the sky is doing - rain, snow, cloud, stars - using the weather the panel already fetched.

sky_events.description: Rare things on a clear night: the occasional shooting star, and a named constellation fading in and out.

show_moon.description: Tonight's moon, at tonight's phase. Worked out, not fetched.

show_sun.description: How long until the next sunrise or sunset.
